translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Mɑ Osee u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n doo n kpɑm nɛn kurɔ wi kĩɑ wi goo u kĩɑ mɑ u sekuru sɑriru mɔ̀. N kurɔ wi kĩɔ nge mɛ wi, Yinni Gusunɔ u Isirelibɑ kĩ, bɑɑ mɛ bɑ nùn biru kisi bɑ dɑ bɑ bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ mɑ bɑ resɛm kirɑnu kĩ ni bɑ rɑ kɑ bũu ni sɑ̃.
Mɑ nɑ dɑ nɑ kurɔ wi yɑkiɑ kɑ sii geesun gobi wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ sere ɔɔsu
Mɑ nɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, ɑ de ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ nɛn sɔ̃ n kɑ tɛ. A ku mɑɑ sɑkɑrɑru ko. A ku mɑɑ dɑ durɔ goon mi. Nɛn tii kon mɑɑ tii nɛnɛ.

Nge mɛyɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ sunɔ sɑri n kɑ tɛ. Mɛyɑ bɑ ǹ ko n mɑɑ wirugii mɔ. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ yɑ̃kunu mɔ̀. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ bũnu gɑnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ. Mɛyɑ yɑ̃ku kowo goo kun ko n mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben suunu sɔɔ u kɑ bu bikiɑru kuɑ.
Yenibɑn biru, bɑ koo wurɑmɑ bu Gusunɔ ben Yinni kɑsu kɑ mɑɑ ben sikɑdo Dɑfidin bɑndu wi u rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ben sinɑ boko. Bɑ koo nuku dobu ko bɑ̀ n Yinni Gusunɔ wɑ kɑ win kĩi te u koo bu sɔ̃ɔsi sɑɑ ye sɔɔ.

footnotes.text: ɔɔsu - Dĩɑ bimi gɛɛn bweserɑ yi yi kɑ gbɛɛ weenɛ.
ditiri nɑtɑ - Yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ sɑɑki nɔɔbɑ yirun sɑkɑ.
